items.source: RepositoryProxyPostProcessor that sets up an interceptor to read View information from the invoked method. This is necessary to allow redeclaration of CRUD methods in repository interfaces and configure view information on them.
items.translation: RepositoryProxyPostProcessor 用于设置一个拦截器，以从被调用的方法中读取 View 信息。这是必要的，以便允许在仓库接口中重新声明 CRUD 方法，并为其配置视图信息。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。该字符串必须与用于在此类中声明枚举常量的标识符完全匹配。（不允许存在多余的空白字符。）
